Evidence: According to the BBMP guidelines, if more than 3 COVID-19 cases are reported within an apartment complex or its vicinity, the area will be declared a 'Containment Zone' for at least 7 days. This measure is part of the advisory issued to manage the spread of COVID-19 in Bengaluru, where the number of active cases has been rising significantly (Source 1). The BBMP has adjusted its criteria for declaring containment zones, now allowing for this designation with just three positive cases (Source 3).
Justification: The retrieved evidence directly supports the claim that apartment complexes with over 3 COVID-19 cases will be designated as containment zones, as stated in the BBMP guidelines. Source 1 explicitly mentions that if more than 3 cases are reported, the complex will be declared a containment zone, confirming the claim's core assertion.
